messages.businessImpact: A set of protections already licensed and available is not switched on. These rules block the techniques that begin most commodity attacks, such as Office applications spawning executables.
remediation: Create an attack surface reduction policy.
Deploy the recommended rules in audit mode first, review for a fortnight, then switch to block.
messages.cannotSee: Settings Catalog policies and classified legacy intents are checked for existence, not whether they work. A legacy intent is classified from its template subtype; its settings and assignment targets are not read. SEC-033 checks assignment only for Settings Catalog policies. If legacy intents or their templates cannot be read or classified, this absence check is skipped.
